hook: Ordered PtCo fuel cell catalysts lose less than half the voltage of disordered ones over 90,000 cycles.

readout.label: Loss at 1.5 A/cm2 after 90,000 cycles, ordered

summary: With matched particle size and composition, the ordered PtCo showed no big performance gain but slowed degradation by suppressing cobalt diffusion and dissolution. It lost 28 mV against 65 mV at 1.5 A per cm2. The result is for one alloy in accelerated lab tests.
title: Identification of the Intrinsic Ordering Effect of PtCo Intermetallic Catalysts on Fuel Cell Durability.
